description: This is a modern, geometric chandelier with a unique design. It features a central rod extending from a pink circular base, from which multiple light blue arms branch out. Each arm ends in a spherical light fixture, also in light blue, with a subtle pink accent at the point where the arm connects to the sphere. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and contemporary, with clean lines and a simple color palette. The chandelier appears to be made of metal with painted or coated surfaces. It is designed to be a statement piece, providing both illumination and a touch of modern artistry to a room.
